title.narrative: Development of an Urban Resilience and Livelihoods Support Strategy

description.narrative: CAFOD is keen on developing an Urban Resilience and Livelihoods Support Strategy which will guide future urban resilience interventions. Zimbabwe currently has 32 urban local authorities that are all at risk of natural, human and system-induced shocks & stresses . Over the years, the vulnerability of urban populations has rapidly increased, owing to the endless socio-economic crises along with other institutional, infrastructural and service delivery challenges. The resilience and vulnerability context in Zimbabwe is broadly characterised by the pre-independence policies of marginalisation and segregation, increasing poverty levels, increasing food insecurity, poor and declining service delivery and poor macroeconomic fundamentals. Previously, resilience-building programmes have been biased towards rural areas, but this has since evolved as the risk of hazards and shocks increases in the urban domain. Various NGOs/INGOs have thus shifted some of their efforts to urban populations to mirror the growing vulnerabilities. It is against this background that CAFOD seeks to generate evidence and knowledge to strengthen the urban resilience-building agenda utilizing a well-documented and informed approach.
